proposals.before: He once served as zhong sima, and even the zhong wei Zhi Bu dared not fail to show him proper respect.
proposals.after: He once served as zhong sima, and even the zhong wei Zhi Du dared not fail to show him proper respect.
proposals.reason: Literal English misreads 郅都 as Zhi Bu; the name is Zhi Du.

proposals.before: Zhu Jia said: 'You sir regard Ji Bu what kind person?'
proposals.after: Zhu Jia said, 'What kind of man do you consider Ji Bu to be?'
proposals.reason: Literal English is a broken word-for-word gloss that obscures the meaning.

proposals.before: Zhu Jia said: 'Ministers each for their lord use, Ji Bu for Xiang Ji use, duty only.
proposals.after: Zhu Jia said, 'Each minister serves his own lord. Ji Bu served Xiang Ji—that was merely his duty.
proposals.reason: Literal English is an ungrammatical gloss that obscures the meaning.

proposals.before: Ji Bu declined and returned to his office.
proposals.after: Ji Bu took his leave and returned to his office.
proposals.reason: 辭之官 means he took leave to return to his post, not that he declined an office.

decisions.reason: Chinese 中尉郅都 names the Commandant as 郅都 (Zhi Du); literal Zhi Bu misreads 都 as Bu, and Zhi Du matches the graph and the idiomatic rendering.
君視季布何如人也 asks what kind of man Teng Gong takes Ji Bu to be; the before is an ungrammatical calque that obscures that question, and the proposed after restores the sense accurately.

臣各為其主用，季布為項籍用，職耳 means each minister serves his own lord and Ji Bu's service of Xiang Ji was merely his duty; the before is an unreadable gloss, and the proposed after renders that sense without inventing or omitting content.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 臣各為其主用，季布為項籍用，職耳

decisions.reason: 布辭之官 means Ji Bu took leave and went to his office/post; 辭 here is leave-taking after the audience, not declining an appointment, so 'took his leave and returned to his office' corrects the false 'declined'.
